Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1255129 (Proto-oncogene Wnt-1). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
